result.description:
Senior Dairy Cattle Stockperson 
Location: Tallygaroopna, VIC 3637 
Tenure: Full-time, permanent
Salary: From $71,550 per year (plus superannuation)
 
Required skills and experience:
•	AQF Certificate III in Agriculture / Dairy Production (or higher equivalent)
•	Three (3) years of recent and relevant work experience

On behalf of our client, Global Skilled Employment we are looking for skilled candidates for Senior Dairy Cattle Stockperson that will join the production team of a dairy in Tallygaroopna, VIC 3634. 

Duties and Responsibilities:
•	Plan all aspects of milk production process including management and coordination of milking shed routines.
•	Coordinate and implement reproductive programs, including artificial insemination and herd fertility management, detection of estrous and pregnancy.
•	Assist in controlled breeding experiments to develop improved livestock strains.
•	Implement calving procedures, including the ability to physically conduct unsupervised internal assessments to minimize the incidence of still births or injuries to cow or calf.
•	Plan and manage pastures and crops for livestock production and develop livestock feeding plans.
•	Analyse produce to set and maintain standards of quality;
•	Supervise animal health programs, handle sick or injured animals and maintain an optimal environment for the wellbeing of livestock consistent with the Australian Animal Welfare Standards and Guidelines – Cattle.
•	Supervise work routines and staff performance of less experienced employees such as an assistant farmhand.
•	Implement and monitor quality assurance procedures, ensuring compliance and that all relevant documentation is kept current.
•	Operate milking plant and equipment in a safe manner, undertake multiple functions including reading and recording instrument information e.g. milk vat temperatures and cow numbers and matching cow ID to calves to produce a quality milk outcome.
•	Operate a dairy recycling system.
•	Calf feeding, including tubing colostrum
•	Assisting with and/or performing irrigation works.
•	Inspect livestock to gauge the effectiveness of feed formulae.
•	Transport, handle and store chemicals; prepare and apply chemicals.
•	Operate farm and dairy shed-related vehicles, plant and equipment.
•	Identify and report equipment not operating normally; maintenance of plant and machinery.
•	Where appropriately qualified, perform maintenance works on sheds, fixtures and fittings, fences and surrounds and install new or replacement equipment or fittings.
•	Transport stock, feed and equipment, if appropriately licensed.
•	Maintain records to ensure accurate information for stock and inventory control.
•	Ensure food safety regulatory requirements are met.
•	Contribute to and implement OHS requirements.
•	Computer literate – operate computer equipment and software packages requiring set-up and basic function operation.
•	Coordinate the response to emergencies for both occupational health and safety emergencies and animal welfare emergencies.
•	Participate in enterprise/industry training sessions and workshops as required.
 
Qualified applicants may apply online.

Valley Park Farm is a locally owned Victorian business. Our first farm was established in the heart of one of Australia’s most productive farming lands, the Goulburn Valley. Our three original sites are bordered by the Goulburn River on one side and Great Dividing Range on the other.

Expansion in 2012 saw the addition of a farm nestled amongst the rolling hills of the Strathbogie Ranges. An abundant fresh water natural spring carries life and nourishment to our free-range hens, where our farm began free range egg production in 2013.

We are seeking highly skilled and efficient Primary Products QA Inspector to join our team of dedicated professionals.

In this position, you are responsible for ensuring that all primary products (raw materials and finished goods) and services consistently meet established safety and quality standards including regulatory requirements. This involves reviewing manufacturing process, test product performance, and driving process improvements. You will oversee production activities, maintain and manage documentation, investigate non-conformities, and implement corrective actions to uphold compliance with industry standards. The primary goal is to stop faulty products from reaching the customer.

Key Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
Develop, implement, audit and monitor quality assurance procedures at farms and primary product processing facilities to ensure compliance with regulatory and safety standards
Check incoming raw materials to ensure they match company and vendor requirements before any production begins
Ensure that hygiene standards are observed in storage, processing and packing facilities, and transport vehicles
Advise producers and processors on regulations related to grading, packing, processing and loading of products
Testing samples of produce for quality, size and purity ensuring that required standards of hygiene are observed at storage, processing and packing facilities and in transport vehicles
Inform producers and the general public of the health implications of diseases and impurities impacting primary products
Advise on the identi?cation of pests and diseases and on regulations pertaining to grading, packing and loading of products
May monitor production requirements as they relate to food safety, biosecurity or quality assurance
Write detailed reports on inspections, failed items, and corrective steps

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Previous work experience in quality assurance or a similar field
Working knowledge of tools, methods, and concepts of quality assurance
Solid knowledge of relevant regulatory standards
Good communication skills, both verbal and written
Excellent data collection and analysis skills
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills, with high attention to detail.

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!

Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum +Super

On behalf of our client, Global Skilled Employment we are looking for skilled candidates for Senior Dairy Cattle Stockperson that will join the production team of a dairy in Sale, VIC 3850. 

Duties and Responsibilities:
•	Plan all aspects of milk production process including management and coordination of milking shed routines.
•	Coordinate and implement reproductive programs, including artificial insemination and herd fertility management, detection of estrous and pregnancy.
•	Assist in controlled breeding experiments to develop improved livestock strains.
•	Implement calving procedures, including the ability to physically conduct unsupervised internal assessments to minimize the incidence of still births or injuries to cow or calf.
•	Plan and manage pastures and crops for livestock production and develop livestock feeding plans.
•	Analyse produce to set and maintain standards of quality;
•	Supervise animal health programs, handle sick or injured animals and maintain an optimal environment for the wellbeing of livestock consistent with the Australian Animal Welfare Standards and Guidelines – Cattle.
•	Supervise work routines and staff performance of less experienced employees such as an assistant farmhand.
•	Implement and monitor quality assurance procedures, ensuring compliance and that all relevant documentation is kept current.
•	Operate milking plant and equipment in a safe manner, undertake multiple functions including reading and recording instrument information e.g. milk vat temperatures and cow numbers and matching cow ID to calves to produce a quality milk outcome.
•	Operate a dairy recycling system.
•	Calf feeding, including tubing colostrum
•	Assisting with and/or performing irrigation works.
•	Inspect livestock to gauge the effectiveness of feed formulae.
•	Transport, handle and store chemicals; prepare and apply chemicals.
•	Operate farm and dairy shed-related vehicles, plant and equipment.

result.description:
Placed.au is looking for a full-time Internal Accountant for our client in Port Melbourne, Victoria. This role is responsible for supporting the Finance Manager in the preparation, management, analysis, and reporting of financial and accounting information, ensuring compliance with statutory requirements while contributing to the financial performance and operational success of the business.

Job Description

• Assist the Finance Manager with month-end accounting activities, including the preparation and posting of accruals, prepayments, journal entries, job cost journals, WIP reviews, revenue close-off, and monthly financial accounts.

• Collaborate with the Finance Business Partner to prepare weekly revenue tracking reports, analyse actual performance against budgets and forecasts, and provide commentary on significant variances.

• Assist in the preparation, review, consolidation, and lodgement of monthly Business Activity Statements (BAS), ensuring compliance with Australian Taxation Office requirements.

• Support the preparation of annual budgets and quarterly forecasts by analysing operating costs, expenditure, revenue trends, and providing recommendations to improve financial performance.

• Prepare Accounts Receivable reports, including debtor days, collections, liquidated damages, and support the Accounts Receivable team to ensure timely billing and excellent customer service.

• Prepare and lodge business tax returns while ensuring compliance with applicable taxation legislation and identifying opportunities for tax planning and savings.

• Compile, analyse, and prepare end-of-year financial statements, including balance sheets, income statements, cash flow statements, and retained earnings reports.

• Liaise with external auditors by providing supporting documentation, responding to audit queries, and assisting with audit activities and management reporting.

• Provide financial and accounting advice to management, recommend improvements to accounting systems, maintain financial registers, and assist with settlement accounting and other finance-related activities.

• Perform additional accounting and financial duties as required to support the Finance Manager and broader finance team.

Qualifications / Attributes

• Must hold a Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.

• CA or CPA qualification (or progress towards completion) will be highly regarded.

• Strong knowledge of financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, taxation, and management accounting principles.

• Experience preparing BAS, financial statements, tax returns, and management reports.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and proficiency with accounting and ERP systems.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and financial analysis capabilities.

• Excellent organisational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

• High attention to detail and accuracy in financial reporting and record keeping.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work collaboratively across departments.

• Proactive, reliable, and committed to continuous improvement and delivering high-quality financial outcomes.

Salary Range

$75,000 – $90,000 per annum excluding superannuation.
